name: Shurink

lead: Shurink is a Korean HIFU treatment for non-surgical skin tightening. It is popular for jawline definition and V-line shaping.
A session takes roughly 20 to 30 minutes with numbing cream, and clinics describe no downtime.

paras: Focused ultrasound delivers heat to a chosen depth beneath the skin, which is thought to prompt tightening and a lifted look [1].
Clinic pages do not list side effects; a provider can describe them. Effects are not permanent and treatment is done by trained clinicians.

chain: Focused ultrasound heats deep skin layers
angle.text: Shurink aims focused ultrasound energy at a chosen skin depth to tighten and lift. People use it for jawline definition, V-line shaping and firmer skin without surgery [1].

lead: Shurink is a Korean high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) skin-tightening treatment, offered in clinics as a non-surgical lift for the face, jawline and sometimes body. Korean clinic pages describe it as using focused ultrasound to tighten sagging skin and add elasticity [1].

People seek it for a more defined jawline, a V-line face shape, improved skin firmness and balance of facial contour [1]. Sessions are described as lasting about 20 to 30 minutes with numbing cream and no recovery period [1].
The name Shurink is used by Korean clinics for a device line marketed internationally as Ultraformer III, from the company Classys, according to web search results.

paras: Clinics describe designing each session individually, choosing energy intensity and the number of shots for the person's concerns, with energy aimed at the target skin layer [1].
Goals listed by Korean clinics include a natural V-line, firmer skin, a more defined jawline and balancing an asymmetrical face line [1].
No studies found under the name Shurink in the sources reviewed. Studies of HIFU skin tightening using the same device family have been published under the Ultraformer name.
